items.title: Visa Expands Agentic Ready to Help Scale Trusted AI Commerce Globally
items.summary: SAN FRANCISCO, November 18, 2026--Visa (NYSE: V), a world leader in digital payments, today announced the expansion of the Visa Agentic Ready program to the acceptance ecosystem. items.title: Visa Launches Threat Intelligence Platform to Strengthen Cyber and Fraud Defense
items.summary: Fraud is widely recognized as a downstream outcome of earlier cyber incidents, often beginning with data compromise, credential theft, or system exploitation well before a transaction is initiated[1]. Organizations that manage cybersecurity and fraud as separate events may find it hard to act fast on threats before they lead to losses.

items.title: Visa Expands Agentic Ready to Help Scale Trusted AI Commerce in Asia Pacific
items.summary: Visa, a global leader in digital payments, today announced the expansion of its Agentic Ready program across Asia Pacific. This next phase focuses on Acceptance, working with acquirers, payment service providers, payment gateways and selected merchants to prepare for agent-initiated Visa transactions. The program is launching with 50+ participants, with additional partners expected to join throughout 2027.

items.title: Visa and Ant International's Alipay+ Advance Cross-Border Wallet Interoperability across Asia Pacific
items.summary: Visa, a global leader in digital payments, today announced the rollout of its Scan to Pay experience with Alipay+, Ant International's global wallet gateway. The collaboration connects Visa's global payment network with Alipay+'s QR merchant ecosystem, giving eligible travellers more choice and convenience in how they pay abroad.

items.title: Visa Brings the Future of Commerce to Life at Singapore FinTech Festival 2026
items.summary: Visa, a global leader in digital payments, is putting the future of commerce on display at Singapore FinTech Festival 2026 (SFF), bringing together innovations spanning AI-powered commerce, digital currencies and money movement, interoperable payments and cybersecurity in one of its most ambitious showcases in Asia Pacific.
